summary: Sequence has one row, Add Media at Playhead…, that puts a video or a sound on the timeline where the playhead is. A video lands on a picture track that is free there, or a new one on top, with its own sound linked under it, and the file goes on the Library shelf too.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Open any screen recording with the timeline showing. Walk: Scripts/playtest/add-media-at-playhead-walk.json.

try.do: Open a screen recording and click the ruler two seconds in.
Choose Sequence > Add Media at Playhead… and pick a second video.
Open the Library and find the video's tile on the shelf.
Click the ruler at the end of the recording and choose Add Media at Playhead… again with the same video.
Move the playhead to the start and choose the row once more, picking a music file.

evaluate: With the playhead over the recording, is a new V2 on top where you expected the video to go?
With the playhead at the end, does landing on the end of V1 feel like Final Cut's append?
Is Add Media at Playhead… a name you would find when looking for how to add a clip?
Should the playhead jump to the end of the clip that just landed, the way Premiere's Overwrite does?
rough: No mock covers the Sequence menu's rows; the row is placed by the placement contract (UX-PATTERNS §Menu bar: Sequence acts on the time).
The playhead stays where it was after a landing; Premiere's Overwrite moves it to the end of the new clip. Left as is and asked above.
The row has no keyboard shortcut. Final Cut's E (append) and Premiere's period (overwrite) both mean something else here today.
